# Outside websites this site is allowed to load code, fonts, frames or data from, or send data to.
# Anything else fails the site check (static.py), so a new outside host can never slip in unnoticed.
# To add one, a person must say why, here, on purpose. Plain links that visitors click are not checked.
keytechnologies.si                         # our own site
lvr-data-a60c1-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com # our own database (Firebase)
identitytoolkit.googleapis.com             # owner sign-in (Firebase Auth)
securetoken.googleapis.com                 # owner sign-in (Firebase Auth)
www.googleapis.com                         # PageSpeed check in the free website audit (key not set yet)
fonts.googleapis.com                       # fonts (marketplace demo)
fonts.gstatic.com                          # fonts (marketplace demo)
www.google.com                             # embedded maps / frames
www.googletagmanager.com                   # Google Analytics: switched OFF until an ID is set (index.html)
www.google-analytics.com                   # Google Analytics (off)
*.google-analytics.com                     # Google Analytics (off)
*.analytics.google.com                     # Google Analytics (off)
formspree.io                               # form handler (not configured yet)
formsubmit.co                              # lead alert copy by email
api.allorigins.win                         # TRUST RISK: free public proxy used by the free website audit; replace with our own when a server exists
ipwho.is                                   # visitor place lookup (visitor report)
ipapi.co                                   # backup place lookup (visitor report)
www.instagram.com                          # one embedded reel on two demo pages, chosen by Shane
instagram.com                              # plain links
